data.case_title: Roof repair invoice from Dachdeckerei Muster
data.explanation: This is an invoice from the roofing company that repaired storm damage to the roof at Birkenallee 15. The full amount of €569.53 is due by the deadline shown (10 calendar days after the invoice date); the letter also says partial payments can be arranged if needed. Pay by bank transfer to the IBAN given, quoting the invoice number if possible. If the amount isn't paid, the company may follow up with reminders, so it's best to settle it or contact them promptly if you need a payment plan.
